description: Top-level diagram editor component. Renders through the core editor shell: a header (document title, named panel toggles, view-settings menu), a single command toolbar built on TmToolbar with Priority overflow, a status bar with the zoom controls, and an inspector with Properties | Layers tabs. The toolbar is a stable public contract: every toolbar group carries a data-tm-group attribute (history|clipboard|tools|format|insert|arrange|search|panels|zoom|view|canvas-size|layout|export|templates|import|readonly) and visibility is decided by ToolbarPreset/ToolbarGroups in C# — never target the toolbar's internal DOM with positional CSS. The additive public GetViewport() (Fáze 6 review fix) returns the embedded canvas viewport in document space — the visible window the user is looking at — so hosts can place generated content (e.g. the Modeling preview's non-drag insert) at the center of what is VISIBLE instead of the page center.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the editor root.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document being edited. Bind with @bind-Document.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after every mutation.

parameters.name: ExportHttpClientName
parameters.description: Optional named HttpClient to use for SVG/PNG/PDF export calls.

parameters.name: FitOnDocumentLoad
parameters.description: Fit the diagram once after the first render of a NEW document identity. Default null (no auto-fit). Width is the embedded mobile preview's fit-to-width; the same document never re-fits, a replaced document does, and user zoom afterwards wins.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in pixels. 0 = disabled.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host content rendered at the very end of the header bar, after the built-in controls (G9 host slot).

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content rendered at the very start of the header bar, before the document title (G9 host slot).

parameters.name: InspectorLayout
parameters.description: How the inspector column presents the properties and layers panels. Tabs (the default) renders "Properties | Layers" tabs; Stacked is the opt-in legacy column with both panels stacked above each other.

parameters.name: LayoutBreakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance layout thresholds for the editor container. Null uses the editor default (tablet from 768px, desktop from 1200px). Pass new TmLayoutBreakpoints(640, 1024) to follow the shared TmBreakpoints instead.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor resolves its layout. Auto (the default) measures the editor's own container width against LayoutBreakpoints — tablet 768-1199, desktop from 1200; a forced Tablet/Desktop/Mobile pins the presentation (tablet: docked panels with at most one expanded, the palette as a 44px rail, the minimap as a canvas overlay, full touch editing).

parameters.name: MinimapInitiallyCollapsed
parameters.description: Start the minimap card (desktop) / floating overlay (tablet) collapsed. Default false (today's expanded start); seeded once at initialization, the user's own toggle wins afterwards and the mobile X1 rule is unchanged. The Modeling tablet dialog seeds it from its resolved mode.

parameters.name: MinimapPlacement
parameters.description: Where the minimap renders. Auto shows the right-column card on a desktop layout and floats the minimap over the canvas corner from tablet down (DI3); Panel and Overlay force the choice for every layout.

parameters.name: MobileSheetInitiallyOpen
parameters.description: Whether the mobile panels sheet starts open (peek) on the first mobile render. Defaults to false: the canvas gets the whole stage and the action bar (Shapes / Properties) or a selection opens the sheet (X1). Pass true to restore the pre-2.9.1 open-on-load behaviour.

parameters.name: OnSelectedIdsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when selected diagram item identifiers change.

parameters.name: PreferredStencilIds
parameters.description: Fáze 15 (embedded hosts, e.g. the Modeling "Open in editor" dialog): stencil ids to pin as the FIRST toolbox library (order preserved, unknown ids ignored) while the other libraries start collapsed — search still spans the whole stencil library. Null (the default) keeps today's toolbox. Pass-through to TmDiagramToolbox.

parameters.name: PreferredStencilsLabel
parameters.description: Header label of the pinned library (e.g. the notation profile's display name). Null falls back to the localized TmDiagramToolbox_PreferredDefault. Pass-through to TmDiagramToolbox; ignored while PreferredStencilIds is unset.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Host-pinned read-only mode: prevents all editing interactions and hides the built-in Read-only/Edit toggle. The component never assigns this parameter — the toggle flips the internal user state exposed by IsReadOnly, so a hosted read-only preview cannot be unlocked from the UI.

parameters.name: RecentStencilIds
parameters.description: Stencil ids the connect dialog offers first (newest first, at most 8). Optional: when null the editor keeps its own per-instance list. Bind it together with RecentStencilIdsChanged to persist recents per user. The list is never shared between editor instances.

parameters.name: RecentStencilIdsChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the updated recents (newest first) after the user connects a shape through the connect dialog. In controlled usage the host feeds the value back through RecentStencilIds (a @bind does this automatically); the editor adopts it only when the reference changes, so a stale render can never clobber a just-added recent.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Show grid lines on the canvas background.

parameters.name: SnapDocumentOnLoad
parameters.description: Whether a LOADED document may be re-snapped to GridSize. Default true (today's behavior: opening the editor normalizes the geometry). A host that persists an AUTHORED layout passes false — a load must never turn into a layout edit, and the interactive snap (drag, drop, resize) keeps working with the configured grid. The gated call sites are OnInitialized, a replaced Document parameter and a JSON import.

parameters.name: ShowLayersPanel
parameters.description: Show the layers panel on the right.

parameters.name: ShowMinimap
parameters.description: Show the minimap (a card in the right column on desktop, an overlay over the canvas corner from tablet down — see MinimapPlacement).

parameters.name: ShowMobileZoomOverlay
parameters.description: The mobile floating zoom pill rule. Default null keeps today's rule (mobile layout + ShowToolbar + the Zoom group); true shows the pill on a mobile layout even chrome-less; false never shows it. The docked bands keep the status-bar zoom.

parameters.name: ShowPageTabs
parameters.description: Show the page-tab row above the canvas in every layout. Default true; false drops the row entirely (page switching stays available by setting the document's ActivePageIndex) — the embedded single-page viewer's knob, never CSS.

parameters.name: ShowPageView
parameters.description: Show page view with shadow and boundaries on the canvas.

parameters.name: ShowPropertiesPanel
parameters.description: Show the properties panel on the right.

parameters.name: ShowStatusBar
parameters.description: Show the status bar below the canvas (zoom controls, read-only toggle). Default true.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Show the editable document title in the header. Default true. Hosts hide it through this parameter — never through CSS selectors (the title is deliberately outside the toolbar group contract).

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Show the editor chrome around the canvas: the header bar's built-in controls (document title, mobile undo/redo, search and panel toggles, "⋯" view menu), the command toolbar row and the status bar (zoom, Read-only toggle); on a mobile layout also the floating zoom pill and the action bar. false leaves the page tabs, canvas, docked panels and minimap (the pre-redesign meaning: everything that lived in the old toolbar). The host slots HeaderStart / HeaderActions still render. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowToolbox
parameters.description: Show the component toolbox panel on the left.

parameters.name: ToolbarGroups
parameters.description: Explicit toolbar group selection (flags). When set it overrides ToolbarPreset; null (the default) resolves the visible groups from the preset. The built-in Read-only toggle additionally requires the host not to pin ReadOnly and the ReadOnly flag to be set. Stable public API.

parameters.name: ToolbarPreset
parameters.description: Toolbar layout preset. Full renders every toolbar group (the set of groups, not a historical order — since the phase-4 desktop restructure the command groups share one row, search/panels live in the header, view/canvas-size in the header menu and zoom/read-only in the status bar); Viewer renders only the zoom, view, search and export groups for read-only preview surfaces. Stable public API: the group set and the data-tm-group attribute values must survive toolbar regrouping unchanged.

parameters.name: OnHistoryRequested
parameters.description: Host-owned history (phase 3 review A5): when bound, every undo/redo entry — the toolbar pair, the context menu and the canvas shortcuts — calls the host instead of this editor's own per-page stack (true = redo). Null keeps today's behavior.

cssVariables.name: --tm-diagram-backdrop
cssVariables.description: Fill of the area OUTSIDE the diagram page (.tm-diagram-page-backdrop). Follows the THEME: light keeps the historical --tm-paper-backdrop gray, a dark theme re-maps it to the workspace tone so the page floats on a dark canvas. Override this token (not --tm-paper-backdrop) to restyle the backdrop.

cssVariables.name: --tm-diagram-paper
cssVariables.description: The canvas paper: fill of the diagram page and of every paper-painted node body (the shipped BPMN stencils resolve it). Alias of the catalogued --tm-canvas-paper (tokens.css), which flips to the dark DiagramSvgPalette.Dark steps in dark mode (TG-004) — a dark diagram shows no white sheet. The printed-paper --tm-paper* tokens stay theme-invariant; only the drawing canvas flips. Override on .tm-diagram-canvas.

cssVariables.name: --tm-diagram-node-stroke
cssVariables.description: Outline ink of the paper-painted shapes (BPMN outlines, edge defaults). Alias of --tm-canvas-paper-ink; dark in light mode, gray-200 in dark mode.

cssVariables.name: --tm-diagram-node-ink
cssVariables.description: Label/table ink painted on the canvas paper (edge labels, cardinalities, table cells). Alias of --tm-canvas-paper-ink-muted so it stays legible on the page in both themes.

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-paper
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (tokens.css / tokens-dark.css): the diagram page fill and the default stencil body fill. Light: var(--tm-paper) (white). Dark: #27272a, the headless DiagramSvgPalette.Dark DefaultNodeFill.

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-paper-ink
cssVariables.description: Catalog token: the canvas outline ink. Light: var(--tm-paper-ink). Dark: #e5e7eb (DiagramSvgPalette.Dark DefaultNodeStroke).

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-paper-ink-muted
cssVariables.description: Catalog token: muted canvas label ink. Light: var(--tm-paper-ink-muted). Dark: #a1a1aa.

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-paper-border
cssVariables.description: Catalog token: the page edge and stencil table-cell borders. Light: var(--tm-paper-border). Dark: #3f3f46.

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-grid
cssVariables.description: Catalog token: minor grid line stroke (.tm-diagram-grid-line). Light: #e5e7eb. Dark: #3f3f46.

cssVariables.name: --tm-canvas-grid-strong
cssVariables.description: Catalog token: major grid line stroke (.tm-diagram-grid-line--strong). Light: #d1d5db. Dark: #52525b.

cssVariables.name: --stencil-fill
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (TG-004): the default fill of a stencil shape when neither the node's own style nor the stencil layout sets one — the five --stencil-* tokens the stencil templates reference are catalogued here so a host or high-contrast theme recolours every stencil in one place. Resolves --tm-canvas-paper. A serialized/exported SVG carries the baked computed value, never the var().

cssVariables.name: --stencil-stroke
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (TG-004): the default stencil outline (also the default edge stroke). Resolves --tm-canvas-paper-ink.

cssVariables.name: --stencil-stroke-width
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (TG-004): the default stencil outline width. 1.5px in both themes.

cssVariables.name: --stencil-text
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (TG-004): the default stencil label ink. Resolves --tm-canvas-paper-ink.

cssVariables.name: --stencil-accent
cssVariables.description: Catalog token (TG-004): the stencil accent paint. Resolves --tm-color-primary, so it follows the colour theme.
